body.statement: For every feasible selector \(s\), \(\widetilde{\mathcal M}_s\) is the constructive \(\widetilde\tau\)-relabeling of \(\mathcal M_s\), and \(\mathcal M_{H,s}\) is its partial SCM projection in the sense of Xia and Bareinboim, Proposition 1 and Definition 6. Fix any \(u=(u_C,u_X,b,s_0)\), any \(J\in\{\varnothing,\{C\},\{X\},\{Y\},\{C,X\},\{C,Y\},\{X,Y\},\{C,X,Y\}\}\), and any assignment \(j\in\mathcal D_J\). The low-level surgical solution is \(C_j=j_C\) if \(C\in J\) and \(C_j=u_C\) otherwise; \(X_j=j_X\) if \(X\in J\) and \(X_j=g_s(C_j,s_0)\) otherwise; and \(Y_j=j_Y\) if \(Y\in J\), whereas \(Y_j=b_{C_j,X_j}\) if \(Y\notin J\). Under \((j^o,j^u)=\omega(j)\), the augmented high-level solution has \(H_j=h\), \(Z_{s,j}=j_X\) if \(X\in J\) and \(Z_{s,j}=g_s(C_j,s_0)\) otherwise, and the same \(C_j\). Its outcome coordinate obeys the required surgical split: if \(Y\in J\), then \(Y_j=j_Y\), equal to the high-level intervention value; if \(Y\notin J\), then \(Y_j=B_{C_j,X_j}=B_{C_j,\delta_X(H_j,Z_{s,j})}\). Thus simultaneous interventions involving \(Y\) and either or both of \(C\) and \(X\) use the intervention value and never the replaced response equation. For every compatible residual argument, \(\delta(w_j^o,w_j^u)=W_j^{\mathcal M_s}(u)\), \(\delta(j^o,j^u)=j\), and \[w_j^o=\mathcal M_{H,s,[j^o]}(u,j^u,z^u).\] Finally, surgery on \(H\) alone leaves \(Z_s=g_s(C,S)\) and \(Y=B_{C,\delta_X(H,Z_s)}\), so \[E_{\mathcal M_{H,s}}[Y\mid\operatorname{do}(H=h)]=\sum_{c\in\mathcal C}\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}p_cs_x(c)\mu_{cx}.\] Every selector uses the same \(\mathcal M_R\), \(P_R\), response-table law, and response equation; only the selector equation and its induced residual law vary with \(s\).
body.justification: This semantic construction lemma makes the macro intervention and every surgical branch explicit before the transport image is formed.
body.gap: Xia and Bareinboim give the general partial-projection identity; this lemma instantiates it for a calibrated selector family with a common low-level response SCM and selector-specific residual laws.
body.consumer: The image proposition can attach a valid high-level SCM certificate to each feasible selector.
